fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN +3.82%) expects Q4 revenue of $240-247 billion (12-16% year-over-year increase) and operating profit of $28.5-33.5 billion (14-34% increase), with profit growth outpacing revenue growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Operating margin reached a record high of 13.9% last quarter with advertising revenue serving as the engine, and Alexa for Shopping users exceeded 400 million with interactions increasing 570%.
